# Lanka Monitor

> Real-time situational awareness dashboard for Sri Lanka — money, weather, power, health, news, cricket.

## About

Lanka Monitor is a daily-life utility for Sri Lankans: one surface where the rupee, fuel price,
power cuts, weather warnings and news pulse explain each other. Trust is the product — every card
shows its own freshness timestamp. Stale data is surfaced, never silently served.

This is not investigative journalism. It is the morning check on a phone.

## Public API

Read-only JSON. No authentication. Cache responses; do not hammer upstream institutions.

- GET /api/v1/health — freshness of every source (`fresh` | `stale` | `down` | `inactive`)
- GET /api/v1/fx — latest USD/LKR buy/sell + ~30-day series (Central Bank of Sri Lanka)
- GET /api/v1/aqi — Colombo air quality when OpenAQ ingest is active

Every response should be treated as timestamped. Attribute upstream sources and Lanka Monitor when republishing.

## Data principles

- Server-side cache only — page loads never hit government websites directly
- Honest User-Agent: LankaMonitorBot with contact URL
- Independent source failures — one dead scraper never blanks the page
- MIT licence — https://github.com/Cookie-Cat21/lanka-monitor

## Optional

- /docs — human API notes with curl examples
- /health — source status UI
- /coconut — Coconut Index share card (HARTI food prices, when live)
